isolation.guarantee: app, volume and output namespace all differ from every panel arm and from every region-repair rescue arm
isolation.two_apps_are_required: the base app copies the contract file INTO the image and bakes COMPOSE-equivalent constants at image build time, so the contract path, volume and output prefix are image-build inputs. delta is a contract-level field, therefore two thresholds are two contracts, two images and two apps. The receptor being identical does not permit sharing. The committed precedent is the existing t4_shared_retained_fiber_5ht1b_{d06,d04}_v1 app pair, which are two full apps differing in six constants.

mechanism.admitted_site_rule: a real nitrogen carrying exactly three single bonds to real atoms, whose (formal_charge, implicit_h) is (+1,1) or (0,0); the action swaps it to the other. This is tertiary-amine protonation at physiological pH and it is reversible by the rule's own symmetry, so invertibility holds by construction.
mechanism.generality: the precondition is a state/constraint deficit, not a cell name: any molecule carrying an admissible tertiary-amine site activates this proposal mode. It is not expressible as 'if source == 5ht1b_2'. That 5ht1b_2 may be the only cell in the 15-cell panel that triggers it is expected and is stated here rather than hidden.

runtime_pin_changes.added_rationale: everything that decides whether a number is produced must be pinned. t4_shared_controller_scored_runtime.py holds protonation_aware_records, which is the function that calls Fiber.check; med_chem_gate.py holds structurally_valid, which decides endpoint eligibility; protonation_restate_program.py and route_distilled_goal_expert.py are on the proposal path. None of them appeared in any existing pin block, so without these entries they would be free to drift.
runtime_pin_changes.app_pin_is_the_safety_guard: _validate_task re-hashes every runtime_inputs_sha256 entry including the app path, so a contract pinning the protonation-wired app cannot run against an unwired one

separation_from_region_repair_rescue.ASSERTION: THIS ARM USES THE PROTONATION-AWARE PROPOSAL, NOT THE REGION-REPAIR LAW. The two mechanisms must never be mixed in one arm or the mechanism becomes unattributable.
separation_from_region_repair_rescue.region_law_must_be_absent: proposal.shallow carries no region_law field. assert_no_unconsumable_region_law_request raises on every proposal worker if region_law is declared anywhere it cannot be consumed, so a stray declaration fails closed rather than silently blending the two mechanisms.
separation_from_region_repair_rescue.why_5ht1b_2_was_excluded_from_those_arms: its witnesses need a two-boundary interior excision plus one reattachment bond, a region shape the bridge-separated law does not draw; the production charge policy refuses 9 of 16 pendant regions on this source; and bond_insert is outside the frozen Active8 codec surface

registry index 13 (jak2): a root whose narrow protonation fiber is EMPTY, which must abstain explicitly rather than fall back to Editing-V2

reported.exact_execution: 1766/1766 across all frozen roots; 1078/1078 on this root

two_caveats_this_contract_records_rather.endpoint_gate_was_transcribed_not_called: that gate evaluates eligibility at its line 129 as 'sim >= delta, qed >= 0.6, sa <= 4.0', which is a TRANSCRIPTION of the thresholds rather than a call to the production Fiber.check. A transcription omits structurally_valid -- the med-chem gate that removes radicals, hypervalent sulfur and iodine and cumulenes -- and the heavy-atom and multi-fragment refusals. Its 14 is therefore an UPPER BOUND on what the campaign's own gate would admit, not the campaign number.
two_caveats_this_contract_records_rather.software_environment_drift: that gate ran on rdkit 2026.03.6 / numpy 2.5.3 / python 3.12.9. The production image pins rdkit 2024.3.5 / numpy 1.26.4 / python 3.11. The endpoint-gate path was previously measured byte-identical between rdkit 2025.09.6 and 2024.3.5 on 8,183 real endpoints, but 2026.03.6 is a further step and is NOT covered by that measurement.
